name: Centenier Mauger

intro.text: Honorary Police, that is. I'm elected by the parish and I'm not paid a penny, and I have the power to charge you. Don't tempt me.

win: Fair do's. I'll not take you in.
after: Every parish elects its own Honorary Police, a unique system the islands have kept for hundreds of years. We're volunteers, and we're nosy.
